product.name: whatscooking.ai
product.tagline: Meals that fit your fridge, calendar, and appetite.

scope.expansionPolicy: Finish and verify the food loop before implementing optional modules.

evidenceRequired.SideShift: Problem validation, iteration, business and distribution hypothesis.
evidenceRequired.Photon: A real Photon 2.0 channel using the shared meal and nutrition state; verify category/channel eligibility.
evidenceRequired.VEYZL: A visible PR audit and genuine finding that changed the implementation.
evidenceRequired.Gemini: Actual model API use in the application.
evidenceRequired.Atlas: Actual application persistence in MongoDB Atlas.
evidenceRequired.NEXT: Real target user, learning, revenue potential and continuation intent.
evidenceRequired.Commit: Working prototype, category selection and separate supplemental form.

competition.deliveryPolicy: Finish the food core, then deliver the committed integrations. Keep runtime flags off until implementation, configuration and authorization are ready. Calendar remains optional.
competition.fallbackPolicy: Remove an unmet category before submission and document why; never claim mock or unfinished integration as real.

recommendation.missingSoftMetricPolicy: Exclude unsupported dimensions from scoring, renormalize the remaining weights, disclose coverage, and apply the documented uncertainty policy.
recommendation.hardConstraintPolicy: Exclude confirmed conflicts; unresolved required facts cannot enter the confirmed shortlist.

timing.unknownServiceTimePolicy: Ask for an allowance or show a provisional option; never claim a live queue estimate.

nutrition.targetSource: Optional user-entered targets, editable or removable.

design.preferredConcept: Food-focused adaptation of the team demo
design.referenceRole: Use the visual style and spacious composition; the food-first scope overrides the original feature set.
design.style: Calm cream background, sage/forest green, clear readable typography.
design.mealTimeLabel: Complete meal activity time, with preparation shown separately when useful.
design.mobileSwiping: Optional supplement to visible Choose, Pass, and Details buttons.

team.mahika: Frontend integration, deployment preparation, validation and positioning
team.kevin: Data contracts, feasibility, ranking and nutrition/replanning explanations
